| `tier` | ACTIVE / QUIET / MINIMAL | はい |  |
| `summary` | string | はい |  {"minLength": 1} |
| `goals` | array<string> | はい |  {"minItems": 0} |
| `constraints` | array<string> | はい |  {"minItems": 0} |
| `decisions` | array<string> | はい |  {"minItems": 0} |
| `open_questions` | array<string> | はい |  {"minItems": 0} |
| `unfulfilled_commitments` | array<string> | はい |  {"minItems": 0} |
| `task_refs` | array<ID> | はい |  {"minItems": 0} 関連：[ID](ID.md) |
| `source_refs` | array<ObjectRef> | はい |  {"minItems": 1} 関連：[ObjectRef](ObjectRef.md) |
| `last_activity_at` | Time | はい |  関連：[Time](Time.md) |
| `pending_owner` | MAIN / SCHEDULER または null | はい |  |
